_comment: Reference numbers the report compares a run against. Keyed by policy, then dataset name (the datasets/<name> folder); a band is applied only for the matching dataset; other datasets get the table without a verdict. Metrics from the reference runs recorded before this repository (held-out episodes 0 13 26 30 43 56 69 79, stride 1); job names and paths deliberately omitted.

band._comment: one-sided: PASS when every bound holds; REPEAT when only joints_mae sits in (pass, repeat]; FAIL otherwise (the two reference runs differ by 0.0005 across hardware; cuDNN is nondeterministic)

svla_so101_pickplace._comment: Public dataset (lerobot/svla_so101_pickplace @ v3.0, Apache-2.0): 50 episodes, 2 cameras 480x640 -> 480x360, 30 fps, 6 joints in degrees. Reference = this repository's own run; two runs (on-demand 0.424x, Spot 0.421x), no band yet.
